title: Bug Hunt 3: The Silent Type Mix
prompt: This program runs without crashing — but prints 55 instead of 10. A logic error. Diagnose and fix so the total is numeric.
boilerplate:
a = "5"
b = 5
total = a + b
print("total:", total)

tests.name: numeric total
tests.hint: "5" is a string: "5" + 5 raises TypeError, but here the string wins by being first — convert with int(a).
